courseSharing.consentDescription: Publishing puts this version online, so students can get the course with its code. From now on, every course you publish is shared this way: anyone with the code can download it, and nobody can find it without the code. Publishing also creates a permanent identity used for every course you publish. It can't be reset later.

serbianScript.confirmCyrillicTitle: Generate the Latin text from the Cyrillic?
serbianScript.confirmCyrillicDescription: All Latin text in this course is replaced with text made from the Cyrillic. Anything written separately in Latin is lost.
serbianScript.generatedDescription: It's updated every time you save, so it isn't edited here. You can change which script you write in the course settings.
